Name: PrintRightGridShowing
Content:
declare @$formRight varchar(4000)
exec FastBusiness$System$PrintRight '&TransferID;', @@userID, @@admin, '@@sysDatabaseName', '01', default, @$formRight out
select @$formRight = case when @$formRight <> '' then '[' + @$formRight + ']' else 'null' end
select @message = @message + 'report$PrintRight$GridInit(this, ' + @$formRight + ');'

Name: JavascriptReportInit
Content:
<![CDATA[
function load$GridReport$(g) {g.add_onRender(on$GridReport$Render);}
function dispose$GridReport$(g) {try {g.remove_onRender(on$GridReport$Render);} catch (ex) {}}
function on$GridReport$Render(sender, eventArgs) {
  var g = eventArgs.grid;  
  if (g._hiddenFields) {
    var a = g._hiddenFields, h = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
      setGridHiddenFields(g, a[i].Fields, a[i].Value);
      if (a[i].Value) h += (h == '' ? '' : ',') + a[i].Fields;
    }
    g._externalHiddenFields = h;
  }
}
function setGridHiddenFields(g, c, v) {
  var a = c.split(',');
  for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    var l = g._getColumnOrder($func.trim(a[i]));
    if (l != -1) g._setColumnVisible(l, !v);
  }
}
function beforeDrillDown(g) {g._args.cancelEvent = !($func.trim(g._getItemValue(g._activeRow, g._activeColumn)));}
function formatDateView(c) {return String.format('{0}/{1}/{2}', c.substring(6, 8), c.substring(4, 6), c.substring(0, 4));}
]]>

Name: PrintRightScript
Content:
<![CDATA[
function report$PrintRight$GridInit(g, r) {
  if (!r || !g._toolbar) return;
  var hiddenForms = null, toolbarIndex = -1;
  for (var i = 0; i < g._toolbar.length; i++) {
    if (g._toolbar[i][0] == 'Print') {
      toolbarIndex = i;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (toolbarIndex == -1) return;

  var targets, toolbarForm = g._toolbar[toolbarIndex][2], formIndex = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < toolbarForm.length; i++) {
    if (toolbarForm[i].Target) {
      targets = toolbarForm[i].Target.split(',');
      if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(i);
    } else if (toolbarForm[i].MenuItems) {
      var subToolbar = toolbarForm[i].MenuItems;
      for (var j = 0; j < subToolbar.length; j++) {
        targets = subToolbar[j].Target.split(',');
        if (targets.length > 1 && Array.contains(r, targets[1])) formIndex.unshift(parseFloat(i + '.' + j));
      }
    }
  }

  if (formIndex.length > 0) {
    var o = {Form: formIndex, Value: 1};
    if (g._disableForms) g._disableForms.unshift(o);
    else g._disableForms = [o];
  }
}
]]>
